visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for depot geography, table routine, each first-layer preparation, auditor arrival, the wrong-ledger closeup, custody dispute, lower-bell interruption, final threshold, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt restates the complete visible frame for a general image model. Fictional offices and objects are translated into geometry, materials, clothing, tools, posture, light, and placement. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, sharp readable silhouettes, cold pearl-gray fog and blue-black mountain stone, warm ochre firelight, weathered bronze and wax, material realism, humane faces, archival-noir tension, cinematic composition designed for click-through story replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generated prompt from the global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups listed as visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide exterior-to-interior establishing view of a high mountain road depot on a fogbound shelf in permanent cold twilight: a rectangular roofed court built from blue-black fitted stone, an open lower arch facing the viewer, and an upper stair at the rear climbing right beneath a retaining wall dark with water seepage. A turned numbered stone stands above the roof facing the plateau, connected by a thick knotted closure cord to the lower lintel. Inside are a long waist-high imperial stone weigh table, deep dry eaves with baskets and wrapped trade bundles, a small side hearth with a black soup pot, and old numbered road blocks fading into pearl-gray fog. A few cloaked travelers exchange small bundles under the roof while cold mist erases the mountain beyond.
visual_continuity_notes: The final depot is one compact rectangular court. The lower arch and upper stair face each other across the central weigh table; the dry eaves and hearth occupy opposite long walls.
Permanent twilight supplies cold diffuse light. Warm light comes only from the side hearth and low oil lamps.
